verdict_history.reason: The final kernel and full client regression profiles were still running.
The final kernel and client regression profiles passed on the reviewed source hashes with zero failures, zero errors and no source drift.

summary: The native HTTP stream boundary, TaskRun admission handshake, immutable binding/token replay, lifecycle compensation and client packaging satisfy the reviewed N1.3 contract. The final kernel and full client regressions passed on the same reviewed source bytes, closing the prior conditional verdict.

native_store_and_http_api.qualification: The server/model/API bytes match the reviewed source. This earlier record predates the unrelated client-side protocol relocation; the current combined 78-case gate binds the relocated source set.

coverage: all public client/server wire DTO schema parity
configuration-only serialization without a live client or credentials
wrong binding and delivery token refusal before transport
terminal intent frozen across an await boundary
client-context reuse on the owning event loop

protocol_relocation.detail: NativeStreamStorage is a structural runtime protocol in the existing private stream-engine module. The public StreamStorage contract remains unchanged, the stripped package includes the private module, and the final 1290-file type gate plus 78-case package/runtime gate pass on the relocated bytes.

baseline_proof.result: The archived base source reproduces loopback bypass when inherited lowercase proxy and upper/lower no-proxy variables are left uncontrolled. The sanitized log records variable names and booleans only.

proxy_unit_fixture.scope: Only the two transport-inspection fixtures normalize upper/lower proxy variables and clear upper/lower no-proxy values. They perform no network request. Runtime proxy precedence and real API routing are unchanged.

findings: Actual admission refused METADATA_NOT_READY when the inherited test profile disabled TaskRunRecorder; the successor uses the real recorder and never forces Running metadata.
Final operator failure initially left an admitted output OPEN because lifecycle fallback handled TERMINAL_CONFLICT instead of the authoritative STALE_OWNER refusal.
Async worker-entry compensation initially lost submitting API/profile context and started an ephemeral server; the completion callback now runs in a copied submission context.
Static analysis rejected a private lifecycle protocol placed in the public streams module; it was relocated to the private engine boundary without changing wire or storage semantics.

accepted_scope: Authenticated native /streams/v1 routes backed by the PostgreSQL native stream store.
Exact Pending TaskRun registration before output reservation, followed by a bounded METADATA_NOT_READY admission handshake against recorded Running metadata.
Immutable reservation, consumer binding and delivery-token identities with stale-owner, lifecycle, cross-flow, version, capacity and replay-horizon refusals.
Sync and async native task execution through real HTTP and PostgreSQL, including startup compensation and no per-record TaskRun creation.
Lost-response and API-restart recovery by a fresh low-level client that retains and replays the exact serialized reservation, binding and delivery token.
Stripped client packaging with configuration-only backend serialization and no server/database dependency in the client process.
deferred_scope: Automatic reconstruction of submit_stream after loss of the whole flow or worker process.
A durable submission-identity lookup and reconciliation path for an output committed before the worker reports its final TaskRun state.
Native source-task SDK and source admission lifecycle; current source routes are low-level store operations used by tests.
Online prefix garbage collection for indefinitely running flows.
Whole deployment recovery, production HA, throughput and capacity qualification.
principal_conclusion: PASS_N1_3_SCOPED. No unresolved safety blocker was found within the declared N1.3 boundary. This verdict is not a claim of source SDK, whole-worker recovery, online GC, HA or production performance readiness.
